sonnet.problem: Card 11's question already says Ezra makes the priests, Levites and all Israel swear to do it, so this true/false gives away its own answer. It also re-asks the same fact, since card 11 already asked about the oath being taken. It tests one claim that the previous choice card already covered.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
